evals.prompt: I want to add rate limiting to this API. It needs per-endpoint limits configured in YAML, a shared Redis store so all instances count together, and it must not add more than 5ms to p99 latency. ESDD this feature for me.
evals.expected_output: Full ESDD pipeline: .esdd scaffolded (or reused), spec 'rate-limit' with proposal.md carrying per-story Given/When/Then acceptance scenarios (standard Gherkin order, observable Thens) and a traced Impact Map (goal/actor/impact/deliverable), utility-tree.md with ASRs seeded from the impact map and H/M/L-ranked QAS (latency QAS with numeric measure), design.md with C4 + sequence diagrams, spec-level MADR ADRs, Taskwarrior ticket graph under project <ws>.core.rate-limit with blocking edges, INVEST applied at TICKET time (not in the proposal), tickets' Verify/Done-when derived from originating GWT scenarios, estimates under 100k, index task with synced adrs UDA. Human must be grilled during the run (scripted answers: yes to defaults, per-endpoint limits negotiable, team owns Redis ops).
evals.notes: Interactive: the runner must answer Product-phase questions (goals/actors/impacts/stories + GWT walk-through) and ranking questions with the scripted answers above. Assertions to draft at run time: file existence, every story has a GWT block, Impact Map table present and traced, no INVEST table in proposal.md, QAS measure numeric, project naming, task briefs reference GWT scenarios, verify passes.

evals.prompt: We already have a proposal for the checkout spec in .esdd/specs/checkout/proposal.md. Run just the QAW and utility tree phases, then stop — I want to review the ranked QAS before any design work starts.
evals.expected_output: Standalone phase entry: only utility-tree.md populated (drivers, ASR table seeded from the proposal's Impact Map rows and GWT scenarios, ranked QAS with validated H/M/L). No design.md content beyond the template, no tasks created. Orchestrator asks ranking-validation questions and stops after Phase 3.
evals.notes: Requires a pre-seeded .esdd workspace with a checkout spec whose proposal carries GWT scenarios + impact map. Assert utility-tree sections filled with ASR seeds traceable to impact rows, design.md untouched, zero tasks in Taskwarrior project.

evals.prompt: Break the payments-retry feature into agent-sized tasks using exhaustive spec-driven development. I will personally run the chaos engineering tests, so mark those as mine.
evals.expected_output: Full pipeline ending in handoff: ticket graph with depends edges refined through the INVEST checklist at ticket time (Independent/Small/Testable, splits by GWT scenario), chaos-testing tickets carrying worker:human, each agent ticket's brief cites its originating GWT scenario with Verify/Done-when derived from the Then, esdd verify passes, and the handoff summary includes the human work order listing the chaos tickets.
evals.notes: Scripted answer for the worker-selection question: human takes all chaos/ load-test tickets. Assert worker UDA distribution, briefs with Story (GWT) field, verify exit code.
